org: Department of Biology, Indiana University Bloomington
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted yet. In 2026, accepted students were told in late April.
how_to_apply: Apply online. A parent or guardian must say they know. A counselor checks your classes and grades. You also need letters from a science teacher and a math teacher.
name: Jim Holland Summer Enrichment Program in Biology (SEP)
what_you_do: A week on the IU campus in a dorm. You hear lectures, join discussions and do hands-on lab work in genetics, evolution, plant science and more, and learn how to prepare for college.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 8, 9 or 10. You need a GPA of at least 3.0, not counting extra credit. You are taking or have taken science and math.
pay_detail: $125 non-refundable registration fee, charged only to accepted students
notes: Housed in a campus dorm. Contact Kody Beaver, holland@iu.edu, 812-855-5179.
